mimi(sec): Auditor asked for a compact evidence bundle showing RBAC change workflow mapped to SOC2/ISO controls, plus KMS rotation/unwrap events and a signed attestation for any manual key access. Can we scope artifacts and an ETA? @raj @tom_oncall

raj(infra): Scope ack. Deliverables: control-mapping doc (1p), RBAC PR list (with approver history), CI job excerpts that run role tests, rolebinding diffs, KMS metadata exports (no key material), emergency access attestation (GPG-signed). ETA: 24-48h.


tom_oncall: I'll prepare Splunk/CloudTrail slices for KMS (CreateKey, RotateKey, GenerateDataKey, Decrypt, ReEncrypt). Will export gzipped JSON + CSV summary. Prefer S3 presigned upload for the bundle.

auditor_mark: Include key policy snapshots, rotation status, CreateDate/LastUsed, and approver identity for manual unwraps. Redaction is fine but provide a redaction map under NDA. Also want vuln triage note if any KMS helper CVEs touched keys.

mimi(sec): Noted. No plaintext keys allowed. We'll redact ARNs -> internal ids and include redaction-map.csv. I'll write the one-paragraph attestation referencing ticket SEC-2026-400. Will GPG-sign it.

raj(infra): Splunk example query I'll run: `index=cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com (eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=ReEncrypt*) | table _time userIdentity.arn eventName requestParameters` . We'll replace `userIdentity.arn` with `user:####` tokens in the exported file.

tom_oncall: For RBAC evidence: will export PRs touching `cluster/roles` and `cluster/rolebindings` for the past 18 months, include screenshots of required-approver checks and CI run ids. CI snippet we'll include:
```
# CI excerpt
kubectl apply -f tests/rolebinding-smoke.yaml --dry-run=server
kubectl auth can-i create secrets --as=system:serviceaccount:team:deploy:ci
```

raj(infra): Packaging plan: `evidence-1789999999.tar.gz` -> s3://audit-evidence/2026-11-05/ with root `manifest.txt` listing SHA256s and `index.csv` mapping artifacts to control IDs (SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9.x). I'll generate checksums and a README explaining redactions.

auditor_mark: OK. Please include a short vuln-triage folder if anything in the key path was flagged. One-paragraph per CVE with PR links and mitigation status is enough. Also include timeline for any manual key rewrap/unwraps.

mimi(sec): I'll also attach the emergency-access SOP excerpt and an attestation paragraph saying access was authorized, limited, logged, and followed by rotation within 72 hours. GPG sig will be attached.

dev-bot: ops: evidence-export job started by @raj (job id: ev-1789999999-01). Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/ev-1789999999-01

raj(infra): Action items: - raj: KMS slices + manifest + upload - tom_oncall: RBAC PRs + CI snippets + review screenshots - mimi: control mapping + attestation + redaction map - tom_oncall: vuln triage doc if needed. ETA: initial presigned link within 6 hours for partial review.

auditor_mark: That timeline works. Drop presigned link here when ready. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

mimi(sec): Thanks team. Ping me if blocked; I'll review the manifest before upload.
